# qopy

> A Mac menu bar utility for selecting text in images or videos and copying it to the clipboard.

The canonical website is https://qopy.combif1am.site/. qopy requires macOS 14 or later. The website's animated walkthrough is a simulated demo, not a native app recording.

## Product

- [Product and installation notes](https://qopy.combif1am.site/index.md): Plain-text version of the site's product description, shortcut, requirements, and installation steps.
- [Website](https://qopy.combif1am.site/): Interactive page with Privacy and Terms dialogs; those dialogs do not have separate page URLs.
- [Mac download](https://github.com/Srihar1-raman/qopy-releases/releases/latest/download/qopy.dmg): The latest .dmg distributed through GitHub Releases.

## Optional

- [Website repository](https://github.com/Srihar1-raman/qopy): Source repository linked by the website.
- [Release repository](https://github.com/Srihar1-raman/qopy-releases): Download releases.
